description: Pierce County Planning and Public Works publishes GPS-located lids used to access or clean out drainage structures, including tanks and vaults. The point inventory covers public and private features in unincorporated Pierce County, Washington, except locations blocked by private gates. Native field definitions include the asset and linked structure identifiers, lid dimensions, shape, type, material, locking status and asset-service status. Location and survey-quality fields are also listed. These attributes can support drainage maintenance and resilience studies; the metadata does not establish inspection condition, repair needs or current accessibility at each location. Access is through the public Socrata table and its API metadata. The provider refers users to county terms of use, so a standard open licence is not asserted. Field completeness, coordinates and actual lid condition remain unverified. The related network-structures inventory describes the larger water-control assets that some access lids serve.
